title: playable-screen-20of44
queue_order: One binary (this lane's step-1 commit, merged with origin/master), env-only A/B per title: ON queues with no --env (app default); OFF queues --env with all six vars =0. Scope at first registration: 20 of pm/playable-accepted.tsv's 44 titles whose ISO was present on the Nova's DEVICE_ISO_ROOT (confirmed against /home/justin/hakux-work/hardware/titlepush/listing-nova.txt, Oct-3, cross-checked live at queue time). lane.local's brief addendum (10-10 22:46 PDT) added Capcom vs. SNK 2 EO and shuffled 23 more titles onto the Nova overnight (unit lanelocal-shuffle1010b, log /home/justin/hakux-work/lanelocal-scratch/shuffle1010.log, done 23:43:58 PDT). The pilot (Alien Hominid) then failed live with 'title not on device' despite being in the original 20 -- cross-checking wt/pathfind/scratch/nova-free1008.log (an Oct-8 21:25-21:49 PDT space-freeing pass this lane had not seen) against tonight's 23 restored titles found 12 titles deleted Oct-8 and never restored: Alien Hominid, KOF: Maximum Impact - Maniax, Azurik: Rise of Perathia, WWE Raw 2, 50 Cent: Bulletproof, Baldur's Gate: Dark Alliance, Kabuki Warriors, 187: Ride or Die, Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 2x, Gunvalkyrie, Castlevania: Curse of Darkness, NBA Live 2004. These move to blocked_titles; the true current scope is 32 (9 of the original 20 unaffected by the Oct-8 deletion, plus Capcom vs. SNK 2 EO, plus the 23 restored tonight). 14 of the 32 use their own named route (docs/testing/titles/routes/<name>.route, minus the five route-having titles now blocked: alien-hominid, 187-ride-or-die, kabuki-warriors, thps2x, castlevania-cod -- 4 route titles remain: Crimson Skies, Spikeout, Jet Set Radio Future, Tork); the rest run as a soak to the title screen with --frames-every. Queued in batches of about 10 titles, each batch preceded by its own small pilot per the 30-min device-time gate, HAKUX_RELEASE_PRIO=1. gfps for a route run is read from hakuX-pace logcat lines (f=... vb=... max=... ms=...) summed across the window from 'mark gameplay' to 'soak end': gfps = sum(vb)*1000/sum(ms), the same vsync-paced-frame count raread.py/fpread.py already parse for NFS, generalized here without the NFS-specific race-start countdown windowing (most titles have no discrete race start). Crimson Skies pilot (first of this batch, refs 1-1791703775-fastpaths1010-4011126 ON / -4011199 OFF): both arms clean (env correct, all four on-lines present on ON and absent on OFF, no fatal/crash/abort, golden disk state both arms), gfps ON 59.90 OFF 59.94 -- no regression, this title is not bottlenecked by the six switches either way. UPDATE (10-11 00:52 PDT): lane.local's Addendum 2 shuffled 7 of the 12 blocked titles back (lanelocal-shuffle1011, done 00:52:50 PDT, all 7 verified) -- Kabuki Warriors, Gunvalkyrie, 187: Ride or Die, Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 2x, KOF: Maximum Impact - Maniax, Alien Hominid, WWE Raw 2 -- moving scope to 39. Six of these seven (all but Gunvalkyrie) have their own route (docs/testing/titles/routes/: kabuki-warriors, 187-ride-or-die, thps2x, kof-mi.returning, alien-hominid, wwe-raw-2 -- more than Addendum 2's own text named, confirmed by listing the routes directory directly), so the route-title count is now 10 (the prior 4 plus these 6), 29 soak titles. The remaining 5 (Azurik, Baldur's Gate: Dark Alliance, NBA Live 2004, Castlevania: Curse of Darkness, 50 Cent: Bulletproof) stay off the Nova per the owner's Addendum 3 ruling and get a screen-table row saying so; they do not block marking ready unless a WIDEN: defect is found elsewhere.
judge: per-title: logcat read for a crash/hang/abort in ON that OFF does not show (fatal); route-frames or --frames-every captures at matched points, compared by region, ON vs OFF (frames); reportasync1010's armed/late counters where GET_REPORT traffic appears in logcat (reports); both arms' perf_regimen.json/telemetry fps, reported not gated (gfps). No single numeric threshold applies across 20 different titles -- each title's own row is read by eye against its own OFF baseline, recorded in docs/lanes/fastpaths1010/NOTES.md and PR.md's screen table.
baseline: Every one of the 20 titles already has an accepted Playable verdict (pm/playable-accepted.tsv) from an earlier run, most on this same Nova, establishing what correct gameplay for that title's route looks like; this screen's OFF arm is that same known-good code path (all six switches at their native C default, off), and ON is the new default. A title regressing between ON and OFF here would be a regression from fastpaths1010's own step-1 commit, not a pre-existing issue the Playable verdict already accepted.
prediction: None of the 44 fail: reportasync1010, texscan1010 (paired with REPORT_ASYNC), drawrec1010 and perdrawon1010 each already screened their own switch (or pair) on some subset of Playable titles or a broader survey without a correctness regression (texscan1010's own finding was a PERFORMANCE regression when TEXSCAN runs alone, not a correctness one, and this toggle never ships TEXSCAN alone). What would refute it: any ON-only crash/hang; any ON-only visual defect in a frame region OFF does not show; a title whose reportasync counters show armed below 100% that OFF's do not (a GET_REPORT race the other three lanes' own survey titles did not happen to hit).
expect_note: fail_titles starts empty: the claim under test is that no SCOPED title fails. blocked_titles started as 24 titles not yet on the Nova (this lane's Oct-3/4 listing check was stale by one: Capcom vs. SNK 2 EO was already there), which lane.local's addendum (10-10 22:46 PDT) shuffled on overnight (lanelocal-shuffle1010b, log /home/justin/hakux-work/lanelocal-scratch/shuffle1010.log, done 23:43:58 PDT, all 23 verified). The Alien Hominid pilot then failed live with 'title not on device' -- cross-checking wt/pathfind/scratch/nova-free1008.log (an Oct-8 21:25-21:49 PDT space-freeing pass not previously seen) found it deleted that day and never restored, along with 11 others from the original 20 that tonight's shuffle didn't touch. Those 12 became blocked_titles (scope 32). Addendum 2 (lane.local, 10-11 00:41 PDT) then shuffled 7 of those 12 back (lanelocal-shuffle1011, log /home/justin/hakux-work/lanelocal-scratch/shuffle1011.log, done 00:52:50 PDT, all 7 verified -- confirmed directly, not just taken from the cross-session message reporting it): Kabuki Warriors, Gunvalkyrie, 187: Ride or Die, Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 2x, KOF: Maximum Impact - Maniax, Alien Hominid, WWE Raw 2. These move out of blocked_titles into scope (now 39). Addendum 3 (owner via lane.local, 10-11 ~00:42 PDT) rules on the remaining 5 (Azurik, Baldur's Gate: Dark Alliance, NBA Live 2004, Castlevania: Curse of Darkness, 50 Cent: Bulletproof, ~17 GB, would drop the Nova below its 25 GB floor): screen the 39 that are on the Nova; the 5 get a 'not on the Nova; owner 10-11: screened only if a defect emerges' row and do not block marking ready. A defect (fails fatal/frames, or armed <100% when OFF's is not, after two reruns) gets a NOTES.md line starting WIDEN:, naming the title/column/result ids, which lane.local reads to shuffle the 5 in. UPDATE (10-11 09:52 UTC, batch 2): Call of Duty 3 (4156005D) also failed live with 'title not on device', the same failure mode as the Alien Hominid pilot, despite being in the 8-of-original-20 bucket thought unaffected by the Oct-8 deletion -- checked and it is in none of nova-free1008.log, shuffle1010.log or shuffle1011.log, so the Oct-3/4 listing was simply wrong about it on its own, a third kind of staleness. Moved to blocked_titles (not a fail_titles entry: it never ran, so there is no ON-vs-OFF correctness result to fail). Scope for this screen is now 38. Full per-title list, route/soak plan and the presence correction history: docs/lanes/fastpaths1010/NOTES.md section 4.1.2, 4.3 and 4.4.
